prompt.project_info: Create a soft diffused bedroom portrait of an approved adult woman in pastel pajamas.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy dirty-blonde hair, hazel or light-green eyes, winged eyeliner, fair skin with prominent natural freckles, glossy pink lips, and calm serene gaze, wearing a fully opaque soft-pink floral pajama set with a full-coverage top and matching knee-length shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium vertical portrait, seated cross-legged comfortably on a bed and leaning slightly forward, one hand resting naturally near the collarbone, dark-grey tufted headboard, cream bedding and stacked pillows.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused indoor light creates gentle shadows, pastel pink and cream palette, quiet relaxed bedroom mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic portrait, vertical framing, shallow background depth of field, sharp face and freckles, realistic fabric and skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic vertical bedroom portrait of an approved adult woman with long wavy dirty-blonde hair draped over one shoulder, hazel or light-green eyes, winged eyeliner, fair skin with prominent natural freckles, glossy pink lips, and a neutral serene gaze. She wears a fully opaque soft-pink small-floral pajama set with a full-coverage top and matching knee-length shorts, sitting cross-legged comfortably on a bed and leaning slightly forward with one hand relaxed near her collarbone. Include a dark-grey tufted headboard, cream linens, stacked pillows, soft diffused indoor light, gentle shadows, pastel pink and cream palette, shallow background depth, and realistic skin and fabric detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, cropped camisole, spaghetti straps, exposed midriff, short shorts, lingerie, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
